metadata.subject: Doors and Closures BIW Design for Bangalore-TPC

content.normalized:
Dear Partner,
Kindly share quality profiles with
@Kiran N
marking a CC to
@Pranati Paul
Please note that the L1 selected candidates must attend the client interview in person in Bangalore.
Open Postions-7
Bill Rate-70000 max
Exp-4-6 Years
Customer Round-Yes(F2F) in Bangalore
Skill:
Doors and Closures BIW design and development
Job Description:
Product design and development Doors and Closures:
Development of BIW components and CAD Construction in NX with Daimler methodology.
Master section creation and validations, Benchmarking
Styling validation for technical requirement.
Concept proposal, Packaging study, Interference check.
Understanding of Door mechanisms, Glass, Hinges and Handles
Creation of joining elements for the assembly
Generating ideas for cost reduction and weight reduction
Ensure quality and timelines of every deliverables in the projects.
Discussion with cross functional teams (CFT) for incorporating feedback e.g., Simulation, Manufacturing, Vehicle integration, Corrosion protection and incorporating changes
Change Management
Qualifications -
BE Mechanical with min 3 years of experience in BIW Door and Closures
